blocks.head: alt The user is not near any device
alt The user is near the device
alt The user is near the device
alt The user has key and the device exists

state_rules.rule:
eq < UserX | ('near' : nils , 'key' : nils , ..) > $ UserX 'approach' deviceB 
= < UserX | ('near' : deviceB , 'key' : nils , ..) > .

eq < UserX | ('near' : deviceB , ..) > $ UserX 'leave' deviceB 
= < UserX | ('near' : nils , ..) > .

eq < deviceB | ('key' : Key , ..) > $ UserX 'pressButton' deviceB 
= < deviceB | ('key' : Key , ..) > $ deviceB 'sendKey' UserX | (Key) .

eq < UserX | ('key' : nils , ..) > $ deviceB 'sendKey' UserX | (Key) 
= < UserX | ('key' : Key , ..) > .

eq < UserX | ('key' : Key , ..) > < cloudA | (deviceB : ('key' : Key , 'owner' : nils , ...) , ....) > $ UserX 'bind' cloudA | (deviceB ; Key) 
= < UserX | ('key' : Key , ..) > < cloudA | (deviceB : ('key' : Key , 'owner' : UserX , ...) , ....) > .

event_rules.label: rev1
event_rules.rule:
rl [rev1]: E @ S < UserX | ('near' : nils , ..) > 
=> ep: ev1(UserX) @ S < UserX | ('near' : nils , ..) > .

event_rules.label: rev2
event_rules.rule:
rl [rev2]: E @ S < UserX | ('near' : deviceB , ..) > 
=> ep: ev2(UserX) @ S < UserX | ('near' : deviceB , ..) > .

event_rules.label: rev3
event_rules.rule:
rl [rev3]: E @ S < UserX | ('near' : deviceB , ..) > 
=> ep: ev3(UserX) @ S < UserX | ('near' : deviceB , ..) > .

event_rules.label: rev4
event_rules.rule:
rl [rev4]: E @ S < UserX | ('key' : Key , ..) > < deviceB | (...) > 
=> ep: ev4(UserX, Key) @ S < UserX | ('key' : Key , ..) > < deviceB | (...) > .
